standard_prerequisites.name: Sobriety transfer
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, lemma points-cartesian and section-references on sober schemes (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Schemes are sober; sobriety pulls back through etale covers.

standard_prerequisites.name: No specializations within fibres
standard_prerequisites.use: The collapse used in the irreducible direction.

core_obligations: (1) iff (2): a decent space is reasonable; a decent space with unique closed points is sober via the displayed sequence of specializations x = x_0 <- x_1 <- ... in U and the finite-fibre collapse.
(2) implies (3): an irreducible open subset has a unique closed point.
(3) implies (2): the fibre over a field point decomposes into irreducible components; uniqueness of closed points forces the fibre to be a single geometric point.
proof_roadmap: Sobriety via specialization chains; irreducible-open forward; fibre-component reverse.
difficulty_reason: A three-way equivalence of point conditions, the sober direction running a displayed specialization chain to its collapse.
